description: #183: when a docs or forced-test unit counts as covered, not only touched. Written on 24 November 2026 before any session of the control run, from the parent's file, the task text and the commit's file, by an agent that had seen the recorded 20 sessions of arm none (their tool calls and summaries; of the files judged here it had read no diff). All criteria of a unit must hold for the file as the session left it; wording is free. `absent`/`present` are regular expressions checked mechanically on that file (the commit's file meets them, the parent's breaks at least one where a unit has any); the text is judged blind to the arm.

framework-docs/modules/ROOT/pages/append.wrong: lists the Spring properties; the new one is missing

criteria.text: The list of Spring properties has an entry for `spring.expression.reflectiveConversion`.
The entry says what it does: SimpleEvaluationContext uses the standard (reflective, unrestricted) conversion by default again.
The page says that by default SimpleEvaluationContext does not convert by reflectively invoking constructors or methods (or: uses a restricted conversion service).
The page names `withConverter(...)` as the way to add a conversion.

framework-docs/modules/ROOT/pages/integr.wrong: tells users, in the Servlet and in the Reactive section, to set the error field on the ObservationContext themselves

criteria.text: The Servlet section no longer tells users to set the error field on the context; it tells them to record the exception (the new method, by name or through the included sample).
The Reactive section does the same.
The old instruction is gone.
criteria.absent: set the error field on the

criteria.text: The sample records the exception with the new method.
It passes the exchange's attributes and the exception.
The sample records the exception with the new method.
It passes the request and the exception.

framework-docs/modules/ROOT/pages/core/v.wrong: says nested properties can be set "to an unlimited depth"

criteria.text: The page no longer says that the depth is unlimited.
The page says that the nesting depth is limited, with the default 100, and that the limit can be set (`setMaxNestedPathDepth` or `maxNestedPathDepth`).

framework-docs/modules/ROOT/pages/web/we.wrong: says form data is read from and written into a MultiValueMap<String, String> only

criteria.text: The FormHttpMessageConverter entry says that a plain Map is supported as well (for reading and writing).
A plain Map type is named.

criteria.text: The result of `read(...)` is handled as Object (cast or checked).
The expectation that `*/*` can be written is gone or reversed.
